config.name: Te Araroa
config.description: New Zealand's 3,000 km trail from Cape Reinga to Bluff. Built from the Te Araroa Trust's official KMZ by the te-araroa-data package, which supplies the trust's own chainage, elevation on every vertex, the DOC hut/campsite records and hand-researched resupply points. The walking route stops and resumes in six places — two ferries, Cook Strait, the Rakaia, the Rangitata and Lake Wakatipu — so lengthKm counts only what you walk; the crossings are not included.
